_doc: Anchor ladder pilot (2026-11-11, with Chris): wild type 2 (humans hunt and forage from 300, never herd) and minimal herding (the factorial's all-off corner: random cull, no pen, no guarding, fodder, shelter, buck management, tethering, milking or exchange), new base, to year 4000, 4 seeds. Wild type 1 (WT) and maximal herding (S0) come from results/settle.
